intro:
# 🏀 REP THE CULTURE. WEAR THE PRIDE. 🔥

**MORE THAN BASKETBALL. WE'RE A MOVEMENT.**

Represent **SouthWestRuns and South West Rise Basketball Club** on and off the court!

From the basketball court to the streets, our merchandise celebrates community, culture, passion, unity and the love of the game.

Whether you're a player, supporter or part of the SWR family, wear the brand with pride and be part of something bigger.

**💙🧡 ONE COMMUNITY. ONE FAMILY. TOGETHER WE RISE.**

---

## 🛒 HOW TO ORDER YOUR SWR MERCHANDISE

### STEP 1 – CHOOSE YOUR MERCHANDISE 🛍️

Browse our collection and select your favourite SWR merchandise, including T-shirts, hoodies, winter hats and more.

### 📏 IMPORTANT – PLEASE CHECK YOUR SIZE BEFORE ORDERING

All SouthWestRuns merchandise is **made to order** and prepared following your purchase.

Please carefully select your correct clothing size directly on our website before completing your order.

We strongly recommend checking the available sizing information to ensure you choose the correct fit.

**Please allow up to 14 days for your merchandise to be prepared.**

### STEP 2 – COMPLETE YOUR PURCHASE 💳

Add your selected items to your basket and complete your payment securely through **SumUp**.

Once your payment has been successfully processed, **you will receive a payment receipt by email**.

Please keep your receipt and order reference for future enquiries.

### STEP 3 – EMAIL YOUR ORDER DETAILS 📧

Once you've placed your order, please email:

**southwestruns.merch@gmail.com**

Include the following information:

- **Full Name:** The name used when placing your order.
- **Order Number:** Your purchase reference, where provided.
- **Merchandise Item:** The product you've purchased.
- **Merchandise Colour:** Your preferred colour, if not already selected at checkout.
- **Quantity:** Number of items purchased.
- **Rep Your Flag Collection:** If you've purchased a Rep Your Flag item, tell us which country's flag you'd like featured.
- **Shipping Address:** Your full delivery address, including postcode, if you require delivery.
- **Delivery Preference:** Home delivery, free scrimmage collection or local drop-off.

**You do not need to email your clothing size, as this is selected directly on our website when placing your order.**

Please double-check all information before sending your email.

### ORDERING MULTIPLE ITEMS OR BULK QUANTITIES?

Email us with your requirements, including products, sizes, colours and quantities.

We'll confirm availability, pricing and payment arrangements before proceeding.

---

### STEP 4 – CHOOSE YOUR DELIVERY OR COLLECTION OPTION 📦

**🏠 HOME DELIVERY**

Have your merchandise delivered directly to your address.

Please provide your full shipping address, including postcode, when emailing your order details.

Delivery charges may apply and will be confirmed before your order is finalised.

**🏀 FREE SCRIMMAGE COLLECTION**

Collect your merchandise free of charge at one of our SouthWestRuns basketball scrimmage sessions at **Harris Academy Merton**.

We'll contact you to arrange a suitable collection date once your order is ready.

**🚗 LOCAL DROP-OFF – EXTRA £5**

Available within a **5-mile radius of Mitcham, South London**.

Please include your delivery postcode so we can confirm eligibility and arrange payment.

---

### STEP 5 – ORDER CONFIRMATION ✅

Once we've received your payment and any required order details, we'll confirm your order.

**Please allow up to 14 days for your order to be prepared.**

Delivery or collection times may vary depending on product availability and manufacturing requirements.

All merchandise colours, sizes and customised designs are subject to availability.

---

## 🔄 RETURNS, REFUNDS & CANCELLATIONS

At SouthWestRuns, we take pride in providing quality merchandise and want every customer to be satisfied with their purchase.

**MADE-TO-ORDER MERCHANDISE**

Our merchandise is prepared following each order.

We strongly encourage customers to double-check their selected size, colour and design before purchasing to help avoid sizing errors or disappointment.

**STANDARD MERCHANDISE**

For standard, non-personalised merchandise purchased online, customers generally have the legal right to cancel within 14 days of receiving their order.

Customers must return cancelled items within 14 days of notifying us of their cancellation.

Return postage costs are the customer's responsibility where this has been communicated before purchase, unless the law requires otherwise.

Refunds will be processed in accordance with UK consumer law.

**PERSONALISED & CUSTOM-MADE MERCHANDISE**

Genuinely personalised products made to your individual specifications, including Rep Your Flag items featuring your chosen country flag, are generally exempt from the standard 14-day change-of-mind cancellation right.

We therefore do not offer change-of-mind refunds or exchanges on these genuinely personalised items.

Please carefully check your personalisation details before confirming your order.

**FAULTY, DAMAGED OR INCORRECT ITEMS**

If your merchandise arrives faulty, damaged or not as described, please contact:

**southwestruns.merch@gmail.com**

Include your order number and details of the issue, along with photographs where possible.

We'll arrange an appropriate refund, repair or replacement in accordance with your statutory consumer rights.

**This policy does not affect your statutory rights under UK consumer law.**

---

## 🛍️ COMING SOON!

Our official **South West Rise Basketball Club** kits, training clothing and additional merchandise will be available to purchase soon!

Keep an eye out for our latest drops!

---

## 📧 MERCHANDISE ENQUIRIES

For colour requests, personalised flag designs, additional quantities, bulk orders, delivery arrangements, collection or general merchandise enquiries:

**southwestruns.merch@gmail.com**

🌐 **www.swrbasketball.com**

---

**💙🧡 SOUTHWESTRUNS | EST. 2019**

**MORE THAN BASKETBALL. MORE THAN A BRAND. IT'S A COMMUNITY.**

**ONE COMMUNITY. ONE FAMILY. TOGETHER WE RISE.** 🏀🔥
